summary: Feed s168_triple is degraded: 3 high-severity faults detected - 27.8% duplicates, 66.2% one-way TCP sessions, and 13.19 Gbps microburst overload on 10 Gbps NDR port. NDR requires both directions and full payload.

findings.root_cause: 27.8% duplicate packets (1817/6534) indicates the packet broker is aggregating the same traffic from multiple TAP/SPAN sources without deduplication - same packet arriving via two paths and forwarded to the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage on duplicates, inflates flow counts, skews analytics and can trigger false-positive detections while masking real throughput.

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker-level deduplication to drop identical packets within a short window before delivery to the NDR, eliminating 27% waste without losing unique traffic.

findings.root_cause: 66.2% of TCP sessions (305/461) are one-way only, indicating asymmetric routing where client-to-server and server-to-client directions are on different links and not aggregated to the same tool port. Broker is forwarding only one direction per session.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs both directions for TCP reassembly, session tracking and attack detection. With only one side, it cannot reconstruct flows, misses lateral movement/C2, and generates incomplete metadata.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker to aggregate both directions of each flow using symmetric 5-tuple hashing to the same NDR port, satisfying NDR's needs_both_directions=true requirement.

findings.root_cause: Peak 13.19 Gbps in 1ms burst exceeds the 10 Gbps NDR port capacity by 32% (132% utilization). Single 10G tool port is undersized for aggregated microbursts from the broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR will drop packets during bursts, creating blind spots. Even without reported drops yet, overload causes random loss, incomplete flows and missed detections during peak attacks.

recommended_fix.why: Load-balance the feed across 2x10G NDR ports (or upgrade to 25G) with flow-aware hashing to keep both directions together while eliminating microburst drops; NDR needs full payload so slicing/filtering would reduce visibility.
